Meanwhile I am training two new apprentices who are lovely but keep mixing up the rye and spelt flours, which has produced some memorable loaves. We also signed a deal to supply a small hotel with breakfast pastries, which means croissants by seven every morning, and the laminating schedule is eating the whole afternoon. My accountant keeps reminding me to keep better records of ingredient costs, since butter prices have crept up, and I keep promising to build a proper spreadsheet. On weekends I try to close early so I can take my daughter swimming, though lately that has not happened much at all.

What should I do about the lockouts?

A) Turn off the verification step for the shared login so any manager can sign in with just the password
B) Give each manager their own login tied to their own phone
C) Open a ticket with the payroll vendor and wait for their reply before changing anything
